alignment.note: Pass the stage as a status filter (e.g. workflow_state or status) inside filters. 'training' has no equivalent in ERPNext.

First open the invoice to read its supplier. Then list purchase invoices filtered by that supplier and compare bill_no and amounts to spot duplicates.
Direct match. Filters are optional, e.g. to exclude group or disabled cost centers.
Direct match. The extra 'project' field is optional. An asset number is required for capex cost centers.

Two steps: run the workflow action Hold (action='Hold'), then record the reason as a comment. Alternative: update_purchase_invoice_hold_invoice sets the payment-hold flag directly, with the reason in hold_comment.

Workflow action 'Request Approval' moves the invoice to the approver queue. There is no approver or role field: the workflow decides the approver. Put the reason, and if needed the intended approver, in a comment.
Workflow action 'Approve', performed by the logged-in approver. The approver is not an argument. This is the approver's step: the apprentice should observe it, not perform it.
Direct match. The comment is added to the invoice timeline.
Final workflow action 'Post', which submits the invoice to the ledger. submit_purchase_invoice is the non-workflow equivalent. Irreversible.

page.title: Invoices over €5,000 gross are capex
page.triggerText: When the invoice's gross amount (VAT included) is over €5,000
steps: Open the invoice and check the gross amount, VAT included (not the net amount).
Look up the capex cost center (0400).
Change the coding from the opex cost center to capex 0400 and enter the asset number.

why.text: Company rule: anything over €5,000 must be booked as capex.

guardrails.text: Never post an invoice over €5,000 gross to an opex cost center. It must be coded to capex and have an asset number.
